checks.finding: Pure timing/poll-limit validation and route resolution precede mutations. Same-section constructor fence rejects static fault before gate/pin/I2C access. Gate establishment is bounded outside the section. An already asserted central reset is rechecked in-section before the unchanged helper; released inherited hardware is not blindly reset. Independent slave SEN/requests/SLVBUSY and reserved CLKSRC are rejected before master-control or pin mutation.

Inherited CLKSRC/DBGEN/SLEEPEN and RESET are rebuilt field-by-field; reserved bits and FIFO strobes remain zero. Entire MFIFOCR=0 qualifies inherited drain; unqualified watermarks go to held master RESET without FIFO-empty inference. PCLK is selected only after RESET=1/MEN=0 readback, with a second held-state check before release.

Retirement fences NVIC and requests, clears MEN alone, bounds eligible MEN=0/TXE/!MSTBUSY drain, then separately flushes both FIFOs and checks empty local state before observed flag clears. Failure falls back to confirmed retained master RESET. Unconfirmed access/control/configuration/gate state latches per-instance fault and thereafter allows no I2C MMIO, reset pulse, or gate retry.

Engine::access brackets peripheral observations and writes with live gate-on/central-reset-released checks. Failure terminates immediately. Complete master/input/timing/watermark/request and slave-disable restoration is verified with MEN=0, then enabling is verified. FIFO-reset pulse readback is not treated as acknowledgement. Shared RCC helper body is unchanged; its fixed 32-sample exception is documented.

Durable Active precedes the guard and first await. Guard Drop retires a polled future; an unpolled future is inert. Forgotten futures are retired at the next mutable entry before invalid/empty preflight. Reconstruction of an entire forgotten reborrowed owner follows the same inherited hardware retirement and static fault fence in both modes. Getters stay cached. Drop freshly verifies local stop/slave inactivity before gate-off and faults an unconfirmed gate result.

Owned AtomicWaker plus armed/faulted flags retain no caller/driver/future pointer. Register-before-arm, vector fencing, stale pending removal, exact phase+four-error MIER and retained-status recheck close the designated lost-wake windows. TXE is absent during RX/STOP waits. ISR masks its dedicated vector and uses critical-section atomic load/store plus wake; no peripheral MMIO or data consumption occurs there.

ARBI precedes PINLOW/FIFO/NACK. Async paths take an error-first fresh snapshot after readiness before MTDR/MRDR. Retirement preserves observed arbitration precedence, with RecoveryFailed dominant. Final write NACK is never suppressed. One normal STOP marker plus retained error-free STOP/TXE/!MSTBUSY is required; no PACKET/cursor/FIFO-only success and no explicit cleanup STOP. Final idle confirmation is bounded after the asynchronous STOP event.

All later read runs are preflighted before an earlier write. Nonempty adjacent reads have a checked total <=256, then exactly one Receive(count-1) command and one final hardware NACK; 257 and empty reads reject. MRDR data and EMPTY are obtained in one read, with no store/cursor advance on EMPTY. Adjacent writes share START; direction changes use repeated START; no RXCNT access.

L012 timing.rs, classic.rs and central rcc/peripheral.rs independently match baseline hashes. Dispatcher retains mutually exclusive backend selection. Ordinary blocking transfer shape and trait remain; shared lifecycle is intentionally corrected. No DMA/slave/ten-bit/retry/new clock source/low-power/hardware claim is added.

Both binaries instantiate and use both native controllers, running four actual transaction forms per controller: pointer write, separate read, write_read, and adjacent-read transaction. Async form calls the real embedded-hal-async trait. Errors halt without retry; raw readings are retained through black_box. Routes, exact part selection, actual 64-KiB/8-KiB linker metadata, external pull-ups, 100-ns assumed rise bounds and separate target/bus requirements are explicit.

Manifest exposes only the two exact C8T6/C8U6 selectors. Build script requires exactly one selector and exact metadata, controller/IP/vector/route and actual memory banks; generic forwarded dependency feature cannot satisfy admission. Static review establishes refusal, without a negative build. Non-root lock entries (89) are byte-structure-equivalent to classic examples; release z/LTO/one-codegen-unit settings are retained.

All six external proposed files match their manifest and remain uninstalled at this review. Contract correctly labels pending ARM/source acceptance, separate Classic Stage87 counts, native lifecycle limits, hardware/electrical nonclaims and historical blocking cleanup. Mode-specific fresh snapshot wording is now exact: both modes check error-first; async takes an additional post-await snapshot.
